item.title: Bethany Linn LaFavre
item.description: Bethany Linn LaFavre, age 35, of Lakeville, Minnesota, went to be with her Savior on February 26, 2026.

item.title: Sheriff's Office seeks security footage from Clarks Grove residents after reported gunshots Tuesday night
item.description: The Freeborn County Sheriff’s Office is asking for help from Clarks Grove residents for information tied to possible gunshots fired Tuesday night in the city.

item.title: Information, concerns shared at public hearing on permit for battery energy storage system
item.description: Environmental impacts, property values and quality of life were topics at the forefront of a public hearing held Tuesday at the Glenville-Emmons High School to discuss the possibility of the construction of the Midwater Battery Energy Storage System in Freeborn County.

item.title: Minnesota Gov. Tim Walz, Attorney General Keith Ellison tangle with Republicans in fraud hearing
item.description: Often criticized and frequently cut off, Minnesota Gov. Tim Walz and Attorney General Keith Ellison faced tough questions over fraud in Minnesota by Republicans Wednesday as the two Democrats and party allies tried to turn the focus to the Trump administration's immigration tactics.

item.title: ‘We hope that audiences will be enchanted’: Alden-Conger School to bring classic musical to the stage
item.description: Students of all ages this weekend will perform a familiar favorite as they bring “Rodgers and Hammerstein’s Cinderella, Youth Edition,” to the stage at Alden-Conger School.

item.title: Freeborn County backs potential lobbying effort against Minnesota bills targeting counties with federal contracts
item.description: In light of bills put forward in the Legislature that would limit a county’s authority to enter into federal contracts, the Freeborn County Board of Commissioners on Tuesday voted 3-2 to allow the administrator to work with Sherburne County to advocate on the county’s behalf tied to the bills.

item.title: Veronica "Roni" L. Wangsness
item.description: Veronica “Roni” L. Wangsness, age 76, of Madison Lake, died, Monday, March 2, 2026.

item.title: 5th Ward Albert Lea city councilor announces campaign for Minnesota House
item.description: Fifth Ward Councilor Keith Van Beek announced Thursday he is running as a Republican candidate for the Minnesota House of Representatives in District 23A.

item.title: Power tools stolen and other reports
item.description: Power tools were reported taken at 10:51 a.m. Wednesday at 80860 110th St. in Glenville.

item.title: Albert Lea man spends retirement bringing joy to others
item.description: Wednesday is a busy day for Albert Lea resident Bob Yaw.
